say:0:1460501001:1.text: Welcome to the first-ever Brimstone Village Melon Melee! I'm Carey, your prize manager.
say:0:1460501001:1.source_cn: 欢迎来到第一届深岩西瓜杯擂台赛！我是大赛的奖品管理员凯瑞！

say:1:1460501002:1.text: This tournament is Hyla's initiative to boost the village's morale and challenge everyone's physical endurance!
say:1:1460501002:1.source_cn: 深岩西瓜杯擂台赛是由海拉女士发起的，意在鼓舞村子士气，...

say:2:1460501003:1.text: There are plenty of prizes up for grabs! Simply use the Melon Tokens and Melon Medallions you earn to exchange for prizes at the <style="highlight">Summer Stall</style>!
say:2:1460501003:1.source_cn: 当然，既然是比赛，肯定少不了奖品，参与比赛获得的西瓜币...

say:3:1460501004:1.text: Prizes galore! Don't miss out on the exclusive watermelon merchandise—it'll make you stand out in the crowd!
say:3:1460501004:1.source_cn: 里面可是有不少让人心情振奋的奖品哦！尤其是为此次大赛特...
